arxiv-2109-02410.description: Abstract The cold and dense QCD equation of state (EoS) at high baryon chemical potential μ B \mu_{B} involves at order α s 2 \alpha_{s}^{2} an all-loop summation of the soft mode m E ∼ α s 1 / 2 ​ μ B m_{E}\sim\alpha_{s}^{1/2}\mu_{B} contributions.

arxiv-2212-09535.title: BLOOM+1: Adding Language Support to BLOOM for Zero-Shot Prompting
arxiv-2212-09535.creator: Zheng-Xin Yong, Hailey Schoelkopf, Niklas Muennighoff, Alham Fikri Aji, David Ifeoluwa Adelani, Khalid Almubarak, M Saiful Bari, Lintang Sutawika, Jungo Kasai, Ahmed Baruwa, Genta Indra Winata, Stella Biderman, Edward Raff, Dragomir Radev, Vassilina Nikoulina
arxiv-2212-09535.description: Abstract The BLOOM model is a large publicly available multilingual language model, but its pretraining was limited to 46 languages. To extend the benefits of BLOOM to other languages without incurring prohibitively large costs, it is desirable to adapt BLOOM to new languages not seen during pretraining.

arxiv-2402-04586.title: Efficient anytime algorithms to solve the bi-objective Next Release Problem
arxiv-2402-04586.creator: Miguel Ángel Domínguez-Ríos, Francisco Chicano, Enrique Alba, Isabel del Águila, José del Sagrado
arxiv-2402-04586.description: Abstract The Next Release Problem consists in selecting a subset of requirements to develop in the next release of a software product. The selection should be done in a way that maximizes the satisfaction of the stakeholders while the development cost is minimized and the constraints of the requirements are fulfilled.

arxiv-2403-10641.title: Quark anomalous magnetic moment in an extreme magnetic background from pertutbative QCD
arxiv-2403-10641.creator: Eduardo S. Fraga, Leticia F. Palhares, Cristian Villavicencio
arxiv-2403-10641.description: Abstract We compute the one-loop QCD correction to the photon-quark-antiquark vertex in an extremely strong magnetic background, i.e., one in which e ​ B \sqrt{eB} is much larger than all other mass scales. We resort to the lowest-Landau level approximation, and consider on shell fermions.

arxiv-2512-20959.title: Can Agentic AI Match the Performance of Human Data Scientists? Thanks: This paper is based upon work supported by the Cisco Research gift fund and National Science Foundation under CAREER Grant No. 2338506.
arxiv-2512-20959.creator: An Luo 1, Jin Du 1, Fangqiao Tian 1, Xun Xian 2, Robert Specht 1, Ganghua Wang 3
arxiv-2512-20959.description: Abstract Data science plays a critical role in transforming complex data into actionable insights across numerous domains. Recent developments in large language models (LLMs) have significantly automated data science workflows, but a fundamental question persists: Can these agentic AI systems truly match the performance of human data scientists who routinely leverage domain-specific knowledge?

pmc-11455198.title: 8705 Autoimmune Polyglandular Syndrome Type 2 Presenting As Recurrent Cardiac Tamponade
pmc-11455198.creator: Ewelina Marta Niedzialkowska, Daniel Shelden
pmc-11455198.description: Disclosure: E.M. Niedzialkowska: None. D. Shelden: None. Introduction: Autoimmune polyglandular syndrome type 2 (APS2) is a rare endocrinopathy with co-occurrence of autoimmune adrenal insufficiency, autoimmune thyroiditis and/or type 1 diabetes. In rare cases, APS2 can predispose patients to recurrent pericardial effusion and tamponade. Case presentation: 32 y.

pmc-11535308.title: A dataset of sandfly (Phlebotomus papatasi, Phlebotomus alexandri, and Phlebotomus sergenti) genital and pharyngeal images
pmc-11535308.creator: Mohammad Fraiwan, Rami Mukbel, Dania Kanaan
pmc-11535308.description: Sandflies serve as carriers for numerous tropical diseases, including leishmaniasis, bartonellosis, and sandfly fever. Furthermore, sandflies are species-specific when it comes to transmitting corresponding pathogen species. Hence, accurate classification and identification of sandfly species and gender are essential for various purposes such as disease monitoring and control, population management, research and development, and epidemiological investigations.

pmc-12525496.title: RNA Signature as Potential Diagnostic Marker for Differentiation of Pancreatic Cysts: A Pilot Study
pmc-12525496.creator: Olga Freylikhman, Sabina Seyfedinova, Valeriia Kamalova, Aleksandra Vatian, Alexander Boukhanovsky, Anna Kostareva, Evgenii Solonitsyn, Olga Kalinina
pmc-12525496.description: The accurate classification of pancreatic cystic lesions remains clinically challenging due to overlapping imaging features and variable malignant potential. Mucinous cystic neoplasms, in particular, require early identification given their premalignant nature. RNA profiling presents a promising alternative to current diagnostic limitations—a molecular lens sharpened by AI-driven pattern recognition.

pmc-12595639.title: Exploring factors associated with clinical competence among nursing students volunteering in Indigenous communities: a cross-sectional analysis
pmc-12595639.creator: An-Chi O Yang, Shiou-Fang Lu, Yi-Ting Hu, Fang-Tsuang Lu, Jen-Hung Wang, Pei-Ru Hu, Shu-Fen Lo
pmc-12595639.description: BackgroundAlthough volunteer service in Indigenous communities provides valuable experiential learning for nursing students, its impact on clinical competence remains underexplored. This study investigated associations among volunteer motivation, self-efficacy, and clinical competence in nursing students serving Indigenous communities.MethodsA cross-sectional, descriptive study was carried out among nursing students enrolled in five-year vocational and two-year technical programs in eastern Taiwan.

pmc-12634118.title: The electrocardiogram reimagined: AI-ECG as a prognostic beacon for valvular heart disease
pmc-12634118.creator: Antonis A Armoundas
pmc-12634118.description: Graphical Abstract Graphical Abstract This editorial refers to ‘Artificial intelligence-enhanced electrocardiography to predict regurgitant valvular heart diseases: an international study’, by Y. Liang et al., https://doi.org/10.1093/eurheartj/ehaf448. Introduction Valvular heart disease (VHD) stands as a formidable global health challenge, affecting >41 million individuals worldwide, and contributing substantially to cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

pmc-12678165.title: Resting state electroencephalography alpha activity predicts cognitive scores in rapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder
pmc-12678165.creator: Raphael Angerbauer, Martijn Piet, Kang-Min Choi, Si On Park, Ki-Young Jung, Alan Jung Park
pmc-12678165.description: Idiopathic rapid eye movement (REM) sleep behavior disorder (iRBD) is characterized by the loss of atonia during REM sleep, causing dream-enacting behavior. Although iRBD occurs without any clear signs of neurodegenerative disorders, most patients with iRBD eventually develop Parkinson’s disease or dementia with Lewy bodies, typically accompanied by cognitive decline.

pmc-13088558.title: TKT inhibition attenuates cardiac fibrosis in myocardial infarction through deactivating AKT signaling pathway
pmc-13088558.creator: Xiaoqing Zhang, Jingwen Qin, Fenghua Lv, Xiaohong Kang, Le He
pmc-13088558.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeTransketolase (TKT) is expressed extensively in various tissues, modulating functions of metabolism and cell apoptosis. However, the effect of TKT on cardiac fibrosis after acute myocardial infarction (AMI) has not yet been explored.MethodsFirstly, we explored the expression of TKT in patients with AMI and acute coronary syndrome (ACS) by ELISA, and investigated the predictive value of TKT on prognosis of patients with ACS by Cox regression analysis.

pmc-13170002.title: Healthy ageing and quality of life: exploring factors associated with quality of life among older adults in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia
pmc-13170002.creator: Rahaf Alatawi, Sara Aljadrawi, Yara Aljohani, Turki Alanazi, Hanan Alshareef, Ahmed Mohsen Elsaid Hamdan, Kousalya Prabahar
pmc-13170002.description: BackgroundPopulation ageing poses significant challenges to health systems worldwide, emphasizing the need to promote healthy ageing and maintain quality of life (QoL) among older adults. In Saudi Arabia, rapid demographic transitions and health reforms under Vision 2030 highlight the importance of understanding region-specific factors associated with QoL, particularly among community-dwelling older adults.

pmc-13179496.title: A case of anal melanoma treated with wide local excision and doublet immunotherapy
pmc-13179496.creator: Mohammad Nizamuddin, Lina Issa, Angeline Rivkin, Sebastian Valdivieso, Aslam Ejaz, Mohamad Abdulhai
pmc-13179496.description: Anal melanoma is one of the rarest forms of anal cancer and melanoma. Due to its rarity and non-specific symptoms, many cases undergo a prolonged course before diagnosis. In our case study, we present a 55-year-old female diagnosed with anal melanoma with bilateral inguinal lymph node involvement.

pmc-13408572.title: Two new endophytic species of Parafenestella (Pleosporales, Cucurbitariaceae) from Xizang, China, revealed by morphology and multi-locus phylogeny
pmc-13408572.creator: Kaiqi Pang, Yingying Wu, Yingmei Liang, Ning Jiang
pmc-13408572.description: During a mycological survey of high-altitude forests in Xizang (Tibet), China, four endophytic fungal strains were isolated from the asymptomatic tissues of Cupressus gigantea and Rosa sericea. Based on morphological characteristics and multi-locus phylogenetic analyses of a five-gene dataset (ITS, LSU, tub2, tef1, and rpb2), these isolates are introduced as Parafenestella cupressicolasp. nov. and P. xizangensissp. nov. (Cucurbitariaceae, Pleosporales).

pmc-13476447.title: The multiple mediating effects of emotional distress and inhibitory control between physical activity and adolescent internet addiction
pmc-13476447.creator: Pingfan Liu, Haioou Peng, Geng Li, Binbin Zhao, Wenju Pang, Xiwen Tang
pmc-13476447.description: This study aimed to examine the effect of physical activity (PA) on adolescent Internet addiction (IA), as well as the chain-mediating roles of emotional distress (EDs, including depression, anxiety, and stress) and inhibitory control (IC). The findings are intended to provide empirical evidence for the prevention and intervention of adolescent IA.

pmc-13680365.title: Entinostat plus exemestane for hormone receptor-positive advanced breast cancer: long-term overall survival results from the EOC103A3101 randomized controlled trial
pmc-13680365.creator: Jiani Wang, Qingyuan Zhang, Xichun Hu, Tao Sun, Wei Li, Quchang Ouyang, Jingfen Wang, Zhongsheng Tong, Min Yan, Huiping Li, Xiaohua Zeng, Changping Shan, Xian Wang, Jian Zhang, Yue Zhang, Liang Zhang, Hongyan Shang, Binghe Xu
pmc-13680365.description: The addition of entinostat, a histone deacetylase inhibitor, to exemestane has demonstrated improved progression-free survival (PFS) in hormone receptor-positive (HR + ), human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) advanced breast cancer (ABC) following endocrine therapy failure in the EOC103A3101 randomized trial (NCT03538171). This study reports long-term overall survival (OS) results.

pmc-13685234.title: Compassion fatigue impacted by traumatic birth and psychological resilience among midwives in mainland China: an explanatory sequential mixed-methods
pmc-13685234.creator: Di Tian, Rui Xia, Hui Li, Yao Yang, Yuxia Lin, Jinqiong He, Weilin Lin, Jin Li, Yuan Yang, Ying Zhou, Yulan Ren, Xi Su, Jiamei Li
pmc-13685234.description: BackgroundCompassion fatigue (CF) among midwives threatens both their well-being and the quality of maternal care. This study examined how traumatic birth exposure, psychological resilience, and work-family factors influence CF among midwives in mainland China.MethodsAn explanatory sequential mixed-methods design was employed.

uslaw-usc-t7-s595.title: 7 U.S.C. § 595 — Fees for inspection and certification; certificates as prima facie evidence
uslaw-usc-t7-s595.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s595.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 25A (Export Standards For Grapes And Plums). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For inspecting and certifying the grade, quality, or condition of grapes or plums the Secretary shall cause to be collected a reasonable fee which shall, as nearly as may be, cover the cost of the service rendered: Provided, That when cooperative arrangements satisfactory.
